grants.label: Unmask the Subject
grants.scope: Recognising or penetrating the Subject's disguise, Illusion or transformed appearance (Success: until the end of your next turn)

effects.text: Failure: for the duration, mundane disguises and Illusions hiding the Subject's identity give it no benefit against you. Fumble: allies within 30 feet who hear you gain +2 status to recognise the same deception.

warps.text: On a Failure or Fumble, the duration becomes 10 minutes

system.description:
GRIMWARD INSIGHT SAVE
Grimward Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 60 feet
Targets Your Judged Subject
Saving Throw Will
Duration 1 minute

You force inconsistencies in the Subject's assumed identity to become obvious to your trained perception.
Critical: The target is unaffected.
Success: You gain a +2-status bonus to checks made to recognise or penetrate the target's disguise, Illusion or transformed appearance until the end of your next turn.
Failure: For the duration, you perceive the target's underlying identity sufficiently clearly that mundane disguises and Illusions concealing its identity provide no benefit against you.
Fumble: As Failure, and allies within 30 feet who can hear your explanation gain a +2-status bonus to checks made to recognise the same deception.
This does not end a transformation or dispel an Illusion. It allows you to recognise the Subject through it.

Warping Options:
+4 PP: On a Failure or Fumble, the duration becomes 10 minutes.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
